title: Characterizing a nonhalting run
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output, and let $x$ and $w$ be Boolean words. The halting-run result on input $x$ under choices $w$ is absent if and only if the machine’s state after those choices is not the halting state.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output
